item.title: The Right Chemistry: Why were nevalyaska dolls once made with gunpowder?
item.description: The story is dramatic, but less explosive than one might imagine.

item.title: Witness alleges at defamation trial that Cardinal Ouellet rubbed her 'derrière'
item.description: Ouellet is suing a woman for $100,000, alleging she defamed him with sexual assault allegations.

item.title: Todd: Where would Canadiens have been with Kopitar instead of Price?
item.description: In an alternate draft universe, Kings star would have fit beautifully as the captain and No. 1 centre the Habs sought for nearly 20 years.

item.title: Refugee claimants are entitled to subsidized Quebec child-care services, top court rules
item.description: Decision says Quebec discriminated against women by excluding them, and it widens the eligibility to include those without work permits.

item.title: If Canadiens call, 'I'll be ready,' Rocket forward Samuel Blais vows
item.description: At age 29, the Laval winger hasn't given up on his NHL dream, but has shifted his focus to winning another Calder Cup.

item.title: 'A real tragedy': Pointe-Claire commemorates child who drowned 52 years ago
item.description: The town inaugurates a stone memorial in Alain Nadeau's honour in Terra Cotta Park.

item.title: C.D.N.-N.D.G. calls on Hydro-Québec to hold public meeting about January outage
item.description: The utility says it does not intend to hold the meeting, but it "remains committed to informing and engaging with the impacted communities regarding ongoing and upcoming work in the area.”

item.title: Quebec’s measles outbreak is over, but cases continue across Canada
item.description: The disease has prompted renewed concern among Canadian public health officials after Canada lost its status as a country that had eliminated the disease.

item.title: Cowan: Canadiens GM sticks to long-term plan at NHL trade deadline
item.description: "If we had found a deal that we thought made sense at the right price we would have done it," Kent Hughes says after standing pat.

item.title: Liveblog replay: Another comeback bid by Canadiens falls short in 6-5 shootout loss to Ducks
item.description: Coach Martin St. Louis has shaken up the line combos: Juraj Slafkovsky is back on the first line, Alex Newhook is on the wing on the second line, Kirby Dach moves down to the third line.
